# Ai Art Spell / Ai Art Spell

> A curated, bilingual (English & Simplified Chinese) gallery of AI image-generation prompts.
> 300 hand-picked prompts across 11 categories, each with copy-paste ready text, source images,
> and editorial framing. Prompt text stays in its original language; only the UI is translated.
> Not affiliated with any AI model provider. No sponsored listings. CC BY 4.0 attribution preserved.

## What this site is

Ai Art Spell is a hand-curated prompt gallery, not a marketplace or aggregator. Every entry keeps its
original author, source platform (X, Xiaohongshu, Discord, etc.), and source URL. The curation pipeline
runs daily via GitHub Actions: pull community submissions, deduplicate, score by quality, apply diversity
constraints, then open Pull Requests for human review.

## Prompt categories (11)

- [Portrait](/#portrait) — People, faces, characters in portrait style
- [Illustration](/#illustration) — Hand-drawn, painted, stylized artwork
- [Photography](/#photography) — Photo-realistic shots, studio lighting
- [3D Render](/#3d-render) — Isometric, maquette, CGI, architectural
- [Product](/#product) — Product shots, packaging, mockups
- [Infographic](/#infographic) — Diagrams, charts, educational visuals
- [Character Design](/#character-design) — Character sheets, turnarounds, merch
- [Poster](/#poster) — Posters, covers, editorial layouts
- [Concept Art](/#concept-art) — World-building, environment art
- [UI Mockup](/#ui-mockup) — App, web, dashboard layouts
- [Other](/#other) — Anything that does not fit the above

## How to use a prompt

Each prompt detail page shows the prompt text in a copy-ready code block with a one-click copy button,
the source images, the detected AI model(s) used (e.g. Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, Flux), an editorial
verdict, and a link back to the original source. Prompt text is never modified.

## Crawl policy

All AI crawlers and search bots are explicitly allowed in robots.txt for both training and retrieval.
Sitemap: /sitemap-index.xml
